name: Play! Pokémon Prize Pack Series One

releases.name: Play! Pokémon Prize Pack Series One

description.text:
Play! Pokémon Prize Packs began with this series on 9 November 2022, as in-store events came back after their break. Pokémon sent the six-card packs to Play! Pokémon stores to hand out at Leagues, League Challenges, League Cups and other in-store events, in place of the promos those events had given before, and planned a new series every six months.

Series One holds 170 cards from Sword & Shield through Evolving Skies, plus Sword & Shield Black Star Promos and Sword & Shield basic Energy. Each keeps its original set number and carries the Play! Pokémon logo; many come both as foil and non-foil, from popular Pokémon such as Charizard VMAX and Rayquaza VMAX to foil versions of tournament staples such as Scoop Up Net and Path to the Peak.
